name: Magik
first_appearance: Giant-Size X-Men #1 (May 1975); as Magik in Uncanny X-Men #160 (Aug. 1982) and the Magik limited series (1983–84)
bio: Colossus's younger sister, abducted to Limbo as a child and returned a teenage sorceress with a Soulsword and a demonic half. Her relationships are shaped by the gap between the child her brother remembers and the ruler of hell she became.

continuity.name: Earth-616
continuity.description: The main Marvel Comics continuity, running continuously since Fantastic Four #1 (1961).

era.name: Claremont Era
era.description: Giant-Size X-Men #1 (1975) through Chris Claremont's departure after X-Men #3 (1991). The all-new team, Phoenix, Days of Future Past, the Brood, Inferno.

relationships.label: Brother and sister
relationships.summary: Piotr's protectiveness and Illyana's transformation into a demon sorceress define the relationship; he keeps trying to see the child she was, and she keeps refusing to be seen that way. Her death in the Legacy Virus storyline (Uncanny X-Men #303, 1993) and later return is one of his central griefs.

events.note: Illyana is taken to Limbo and returns moments later aged seven years.
Illyana dies of the Legacy Virus.
